Typo 2.5.0 adds a sync button to the file tree.

## Download

| Platform | File | How to start it |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Linux, x86-64 | `typo-2.5.0-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` | Unpack it and run `./install.sh`. Then open Typo from the app launcher, or run `typo`. |
| macOS, Apple silicon | `typo-2.5.0-macos-arm64.zip` | Unzip it and move `Typo.app` to Applications. The app is not notarized, so right-click it and choose **Open** the first time. |
| Windows, x86-64 | `typo-2.5.0-windows-x86_64.zip` | Unzip it and run `typo.exe`. The app is not signed, so Windows SmartScreen can warn you. Choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**. |

There is no Android APK.

In Typo 2.0.0 or later, select **Update** at the top right to install this version. Quire 1.0.0 and 1.1.0 can't install Typo themselves: see the [2.0.0 notes](https://github.com/kurtlieber/typo/releases/tag/v2.0.0) to move from Quire.

## Changed since 2.4.0

- A sync button sits next to **New folder** at the top of the file tree. Select it to sync the notes folder now, whatever **When to sync** is set to. It shows once sync is set up and its test has passed, and it turns the accent color while a sync runs.
